①Installed Applications/Packages. We do not share your primary account information with any third party. Such information is collected, uploaded, and used for the sole purpose of confirming your that your VIP information is accurate and granting the premium feature to you.
③Crash Logs. We track and retain logs regarding crashes users experience while using the Ứng dụng song song. These logs contain information about the error types, timestamp that the error occurred, and general device information listed above. No personal information is stored in crash logs."
